Plexus PLXS business model transition go-to-market change 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 描述 Plexus 依三大市場板塊（航太國防、醫療生技、工業）做業務開發，除特定 go-to-market 團隊外不為特定板塊專設資源；原料向製造商及授權經銷商採購，屬 B2B 合約製造模式，一手文件未顯示通路或商業模式轉移。
findings.excerpt: Although our current business development focus is based on our targeted market sectors of Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences, and Industrial, we evaluate our financial performance and allocate our resources geographically

channel_business_model_shift.note: 兩次搜尋（通路／商業模式轉移）未找到 2026 年 Plexus 通路破壞、訂閱化、D2C 或平台化的來源；搜尋結果僅見財報與聚合站，未描述商業模式轉變。
